name: ═══════════════ CAMERA WATCHDOGS (DOMAIN 612) ═══════════════
info:
## Camera Watchdogs (Flow 612)

Monitors each Tapo camera via `garden/camera/{slug}/health`.

- **Heartbeat:** `online` payload from tapo-monitor (~every 60 s)
- **Timeout:** 2 minutes without `online`
- **Explicit offline:** immediate alert when monitor publishes `offline`
- **Alerts:** Telegram (transitions only), via flow 90 sender

Also enrolled on SMS Gateway watchdog as `camera_{slug}` (60 s interval) from tapo-monitor.
